The glossary maps it to Delivery CSAT for customers.","evidence_quote":"Customer happiness: from 4.0 to 4.4 within 12 weeks.","citations":["metrics-glossary#deprecated-and-ambiguous-terms"],"recommendation":"Replace it with Delivery CSAT, or another canonical metric, and restate the baseline and target against that definition."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Responsible AI review not recorded","detail":"The proposal deploys a GenAI LLM chatbot on customer order data. The policy requires a Responsible AI review, and the proposal only says vendor selection is in progress.","evidence_quote":"Deploy a GenAI chatbot using an LLM that identifies the customer by phone number and answers order status questions from order history.","citations":["policy-compliance#generative-ai-with-company-data"],"recommendation":"Complete and record a Responsible AI review covering approved models, data handling, and human oversight before launch."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Privacy review not recorded","detail":"The chatbot identifies customers by phone number and reads their order history, which is personal data. No Privacy review is recorded.","evidence_quote":"identifies the customer by phone number","citations":["policy-compliance#customer-location-and-personal-data"],"recommendation":"Complete a Privacy review (DPIA) covering purpose limitation and retention, and record it in the proposal."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Unsourced 60% deflection claim","detail":"The 60% contact deflection figure is stated with no source, benchmark, or pilot data.","evidence_quote":"We expect the chatbot to deflect 60% of contacts.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite a source such as a vendor benchmark or pilot data, or remove the figure and frame it as a hypothesis to test."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Experiment duration under 14 days","detail":"The plan runs 3 weeks, which meets the 14-day minimum, but the MDE is set on contacts and is not tied to the success metric. The standard requires a pre-registered primary metric with an MDE, and the stated primary metric is undefined.","evidence_quote":"MDE: 0.5 contacts per 100, power 80%. Primary metric and stopping rule pre-registered.","citations":["experimentation-standards#pre-registration"],"recommendation":"Name a canonical primary metric and give its MDE and sample size or power. Make sure the MDE matches that metric."}]}
